selection: largest certified lower symmetric relative weight gap, first in fixed order on ties
strong_gate: weight gap > 0.1*(norm0+norm1), TV upper <=1/4, exact geometry and intrinsic gates
stop: one fixed finite search, no adaptive enlargement
fixed: all four landmarks, root, outer interval, density, physical normalization and B domain
channel: 90 recorded interval counts, all overlaps of any order, optional total B count; fixed selected-node order
